title: Patient Administrator
description: We are looking for an organised, efficient and friendly patient administrator for this newly designed post. The postholder will be responsible for clearing the task list in SystmOne, ringing and booking patients in for reviews and tests, and responding to queries. They will work alongside the care navigation team and clinical teams to help deliver an excellent standard of care for our patients. The post is 24-28 hours per week, with days and hours to suit the successful candidate. A GP practice is a fast-paced, teamworking environment, requiring the ability to work under pressure and to absorb regular changes. Excellent attention to detail and high levels of accuracy are required to ensure an excellent and safe service for our patients. Candidates who recently applied for the temporary admin/secretarial post are welcome to apply for this post. Responsible for clearing the admin team task list throughout the week, which will include: Contacting patients to arrange their healthcare reviews, blood tests, etc. either by phone, Anima (eConsultation/SMS system), email or letter. Dealing with patients in a caring, respectful and polite manner. Ensuring patients are kept up to date with the progress of any routine issue they may have raised, e.g. an update on their care pathway, prescription query, etc. Arranging home blood pressure monitoring. Ensuring patient information is passed onto the correct staff member in a timely manner and recorded clearly on the patient record. Liaising with clinical colleagues and managerial staff to ensure the most efficient use of the appointment system. The Patient Administrator is primarily responsible for clearing the admin task list in SystmOne Workflow and booking patients in for their reviews and/or tests in an organised and efficient manner. This post involves a lot of patient contact and so the postholder will be friendly, polite, caring and professional. Primary responsibilities: Clearing the admin teams task list in SystmOne workflow. Contacting patients to organise healthcare reviews and tests, in a kind and courteous manner. Putting patients at ease and providing clear, concise information. Making clear and concise notes of patient interactions and ensuring these are documented accurately in the SystmOne clinical software tool. Dealing appropriately with instructions and queries from clinicians and outside agencies. Maintaining strict confidentiality in relation to all issues concerned within requirements of the Data Protection Act 1984, Information Governance and Caldicott Principles. Remaining up to date with all statutory and mandatory training. Additional (as appropriate) Dealing with patient requests received via the online consult system. Responding to email requests received, as appropriate. Supporting the pharmacy team with patient prescription requests.

title: Medical Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: Job Description This position is perfect for individuals who enjoy helping others, have a passion for health and wellness, and are looking for a team-based work environment. To have a thorough knowledge of all Practice procedures. To work in accordance of written protocols. Using your own judgment and communication skills ensure that patients with no prior appointment but who need urgent consultation are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Explain Practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are completed. Receive and make telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Enter requests for home visits onto clinical system, ensuring careful recording of all relevant details and where necessary refer to Duty Doctor. Action repeat prescription requests and ensure that they are ready for collection by the patient within 48 hours, either on the computer or manually. Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non General Medical Services) services, accept payment and issue receipts for same.
